leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a service worker to cache static assets for offline functionality
Configure a web app manifest to enable installation on mobile devices
Construct a responsive UI that adapts to different screen sizes and orientations
Initialize push notification registration and handle incoming messages
Integrate background sync to queue user actions when offline
Manipulate the DOM to display cached content during network interruptions
Apply responsive image techniques to optimize performance across devices
